settings.heading: Every home has a story
settings.lede: Once upon a time, homes were rich with character, intricate details, and told stories about generations of family history. Today’s modern world however, looks quite different, doesn’t it? Now you walk into your average home and find just that — average looking, mass produced furniture that has little to say about its home or its history.
settings.image_alt: Carved wooden diwan with bolster cushions beside a lamp and side table

settings.text: There’s just something about the past that has always enchanted us.

We wanted to create a space where people could find quality home furnishings filled with character that both tell a story and invoke the charm and romance of times past. You might find a little fusion of old and new too!

settings.heading: That’s why we created Furnisquare
settings.image_alt: Solid sheesham king size bed with a matching bedside table in a warm-lit bedroom

settings.quote: We believe that every home has a story.
settings.caption: Whether you’re looking to begin your story, add to it, or start fresh, Furnisquare is here to help you craft a beautiful one that will speak for generations to come.
